title: Bib Collection Readiness Due-Soon Queue
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=race:bib
| eval days_to_due=round((pickup_deadline_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_due>=0 AND days_to_due<=14 AND pickup_status!="collected"
| table _time race_name pickup_status days_to_due
| sort days_to_due
description: Builds a queue of bib pickups that are due soon but not yet marked complete.
value: Due-soon queues are what keep small admin tasks from turning into expensive or embarrassing misses.
implementation: Populate `pickup_deadline_epoch` and normalize `pickup_status` so the queue only shows genuinely actionable work.
visualization: Table of due-soon bib pickups sorted by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which bib pickups are coming due soon and still need attention.
